headline: YouTube is changing how it counts views to give the numbers a boost
summary: YouTube is updating its view counting system. A view will now count as soon as a video starts playing. This change, effective August 24th, will lead to faster increases in creator view counts.

headline: The Analogue Pocket gets a Supreme makeover in red or gold
summary: Analogue and Supreme are collaborating on special edition Pockets. The handhelds will come in metallic red and gold finishes. They are part of Supreme's fall/winter 2026 collection.

headline: Sonos finally added Live Activities controls for your iPhone lockscreen
summary: Sonos updated its mobile app with iOS Live Activities support. iPhone users now have quick playback controls on their lockscreen. This was a highly requested and anticipated feature.

headline: Trump’s dumb border wall
summary: A 200-year-old cottonwood tree in Patagonia, Arizona, is imperiled. The tree's stress is linked to the nearby border wall construction. The article highlights environmental impacts of the wall.

headline: IT: Welcome to Derry Season 2 Renewed, Will Cover Bradley Gang Massacre
summary: HBO officially renewed "IT: Welcome to Derry" for Season 2. The new season will travel back to 1935. It will adapt Stephen King's infamous Bradley Gang massacre.

headline: Nearly Triple Your Nintendo Switch 2 Playtime With This $14 Iniu 10,000mAh Power Bank
summary: A $14 Iniu 10,000mAh power bank can nearly triple Nintendo Switch 2 playtime. It offers extended portable gaming sessions. The power bank also supports 45W fast charging.

headline: The Popular Budget-Friendly Flashforge Adventurer 5M 3D Printer Drops to a Mere $132 Shipped
summary: The Flashforge Adventurer 5M 3D printer is now available for just $132. This budget-friendly option is considered a solid entry-level choice. It's noted as the best price seen for the model.

headline: 'Garbage Universe That Disrespects the Characters of DC' — Lanterns' Episode One Ending Has Upset a Lot of Green Lantern Fans
summary: The ending of "Lanterns" Episode One has significantly upset Green Lantern fans. Many fans feel the show disrespects DC characters and its universe. The creators reportedly anticipated this negative fan response.

headline: Trump threatens to bomb US ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran deal
summary: Trump reportedly threatened to bomb US ally Oman. The threat relates to Oman's involvement in Iran deal negotiations. This comes as a 60-day peace negotiation window expires.

headline: Actors lead tributes to 'amazing' Hayden Panettiere after Heroes star dies aged 36
summary: Actress Hayden Panettiere has died at age 36. Tributes are pouring in from fellow actors and fans. Panettiere was well-known for her roles in TV shows like "Heroes" and "Nashville."

headline: Burnham exchanged messages with person posing as Trump's chief of staff
summary: Burnham reportedly exchanged messages with an impostor. The individual falsely claimed to be Trump's chief of staff. Downing Street has declined to comment on the security breach.

headline: Parents pushed to breaking point by Child Maintenance Service, BBC told
summary: Parents are reportedly at breaking point due to the Child Maintenance Service. Mothers describe struggles to secure payments from ex-partners. Fathers claim they have been wrongly overcharged thousands.
